faq.question: Is EZ Order Printer really free?
faq.answer: Yes. During early access every store gets the full app on the Free plan: all document types, templates, printing, PDF downloads and email automation. There is no credit card to enter.

faq.question: How does billing work?
faq.answer: Every charge for a Shopify app goes through Shopify Billing and shows up on your regular Shopify invoice. We never ask for your card details. On the Free plan there is nothing to bill.

faq.question: What happens when paid plans launch?
faq.answer: We will announce new plans in the app and by email before anything changes, and early adopters hear first. You will always approve any charge in Shopify yourself; nothing is upgraded without your confirmation.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: There is no trial to run out: the Free plan is the full product. If paid plans with a trial are added later, the trial terms will be shown on the Shopify approval screen.

faq.question: Can I cancel or uninstall at any time?
faq.answer: Yes. Uninstall the app from your Shopify admin whenever you like. Your data is handled as described in our privacy policy, including Shopify's data-deletion requests.
